cases.name: Jan and KoboldCPP contexts: fit, kept, missing; apply

files.content:
model:
  default: old-model
  provider: llama-local
  base_url: ''
providers:
  llama-local:
    name: llama.cpp (local)
    api: http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1
    api_key: local
    default_model: old-model
    discover_models: false
    models:
      old-model: {}
  other-local:
    name: Other
    default_model: other-1
    models:
      other-1: {}
terminal: x

providers:
  llama-local:
    auth: none
    baseUrl: "http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1"
    api: openai-completions
    models:
      - id: "old-model"
        name: "old-model"

theme: dark
modelRoles:
  default: "llama-local/old-model"
  smol: x/y

# my profile
- id: llm-pi-ai
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai'
  config:
    providers:
      llama-local:
        displayName: llama.cpp (local)
        api: openai-completions
        baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1
        headers:
          Authorization: Bearer local
        models:
        - id: old-model
          contextWindow: 4096
      cloud:
        api: x
        enabled: yes
        port: 0x1F
- id: agent-default-model
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-default-model'
  config:
    provider: llama-local
    model: old-model
